pipeline.modality: Autologous selected renal cell therapy (image-guided percutaneous intra-renal injection)
pipeline.target: Renal tubular epithelial cells (regenerative cell therapy)

indications.indication: Advanced chronic kidney disease (CKD Stage 3b/4) with type 2 diabetes
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 randomized, blinded, bilateral kidney dosing, sham-controlled efficacy/safety study; ~80 sites in US, Mexico, Taiwan; eGFR slope as surrogate endpoint per FDA agreement (accelerated approval)
key_milestones: FDA agreement on eGFR slope as accelerated-approval surrogate endpoint (Type B meeting July 2025)

excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT05018416 (REGEN-007 Phase 2) — COMPLETED May 2025; results presented
NCT05286853 (PROACT 2 / REGEN-016 Phase 3 ex-US) — WITHDRAWN/discontinued in favor of PROACT 1 only
